articles.title: Senate Republicans Move Campaign Money From North Carolina to Kansas
articles.summary: A big Republican campaign group is pulling back in North Carolina and spending more in Kansas. The midterm elections are a month away and will help decide who controls Congress.

articles.title: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Passes 4,000 Deaths
articles.summary: Congo's health ministry says more than 4,000 people have died in an Ebola outbreak. Workers face money problems and safety risks, and case numbers are slowing in some places.

articles.title: Kyiv's Mayor Says Russian Strikes Are Hitting the City's Key Services
articles.summary: Kyiv's mayor says Russian strikes are hitting bridges, data centers and housing. A key bridge was hit again on Friday, and metro and car traffic across it has stopped.
